title: Coefficient Frobenius pairs and the exceptional and shifted Tate endpoints
statement: Fix a finite field datum D and coefficient setting P [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], with prime ell different from the characteristic, and let a_0:X_0 -> Spec D.k0 be separated of finite type. Use the native derived Weil category and its homology sheaves [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. Let c_0 compactify a_0 and S be a coefficient-normalized exceptional adjunction system [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Let Q be the common-stage geometric Frobenius pullback and Pairs its category of objects with an invertible structure QK -> K [def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category]. Define E_S as G_S(1) with structure the inverse-exchange right mate followed by G_S(theta_0); define T_d=H_d(1) with the actual root-line, tensor-unit and even-shift structure canonicalSourceTheta [def-pur-canonical-purity-source-transports, lem-pur-constant-purity-frobenius-square].  These are exactly the previously recorded Pairs, E_S and T_d; this node separates their declarations from the comparison theorem.

proof.text: Use sourceFrobenius for Pairs. Apply G to the unit, with exceptionalIso followed by G of its unit action. Apply the canonical shifted Tate source to the point unit with canonicalSourceTheta. These are unchanged definitions.
